item.title: Good vs. Evil
item.description: For the purposes of this article here are my definitions. Good: Is based on Judeo-Christian values as documented in the Bible. This includes the Ten Commandments plus the directive by Jesus to love our neighbors as ourselves. This is the bedrock of Western civilization. This is the foundation of the United States Constitution. Evil: Is everything contrary to Judeo-Christian values. This includes any tyranny, socialism, communism, and the New World Order.

item.title: If Life Gives USA a Lemon -- Did Feds Just Incarcerate a Fruit?!!
item.description: Permanent leftist scold Don Lemon has been arrested for terrorizing poor kids by invading their church and yelling his caustic Wokisms at them as they whimpered and sobbed. Writes the Hill: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon was arrested by fed authorities in LA, CA late Thursday night. Lemon, now an independent journalist and implacable President Trump critic, was involved in anti-immigration protests at a Minnesota church.

item.title: The Road to Communism: ﻿Schools As Propaganda Mills
item.description: In case you haven't noticed, we have a communist revolution on our hands. It began in earnest in 1962 when our Supreme Court decided that Judeo-Christian values were to be excluded from our public schools. It initiated a profound shift in American education that opened the door to insidious indoctrination that has permeated our society.

item.title: Democrats Attempting to Undermine Deportation Process Via Search Warrants
item.description: Democrats are floating the idea of requiring Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents (ICE) to have a search warrant before they can question or arrest anyone on the street who appears to be illegal or hostile toward police. Is this lunatic or what? Do they need a special permit to use the restroom too? The socialist deep state is doing everything it can to intimidate our police and military.

item.title: I Can't Support Democrats' Mass Migration and Disarmament Policies In 2026-Or Ever
item.description: Guys, I'm not on 'team red' (Republicans) or 'team blue' (Democrats). The DNC nor RNC type up my 'independent-independent' political identity. Consequently, I'm not opposed to the critique of both major political parties in fact being a 'uniparty' or 'duopoly' instead of distinct ideological entities.

item.title: Here’s the Truth—and it’s Not Pretti
item.description: In reality, the extreme focus on Minneapolis protester Alex Pretti’s death is a distraction. It may sound terrible to say because, of course, human life is sacred. (Now, if only the Left accepted this on abortion.) But the real point here is not that Pretti is dead, but what got him that way. And, no, it wasn’t blood-lusting ICE agents salivating for their next victim.
